svg.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.text: PV STRING - 3 x Aiko modules (Karmalkar-Haneefa model)
bypass diode and Cpv per module, 1.5 m of cable per lead (Xcab lumps)
BOARD CAPACITORS C1-C4 (130 uF hybrid polymer + ESL)
IRRADIANCE per module in W/m2 (E1..E3), pattern chosen by CASE: 1 = all 1000, 2 = PV2 at 600, 3 = PV3 at 400
left: 12 V rail, bootstrap, drivers for leg A | middle: leg A, coupled inductor + hall sensor paths, leg B (mirrored) | right: leg B drivers and bootstrap, HF-cap footprints
CONVERTER 2 - rails PV2P (T2) / PV3P (M2 = inductor common node) / GND (B2); 12 V gate-drive rail VREG2 referenced to GND
left: 12 V rail, bootstrap, drivers for leg A | middle: leg A, coupled inductor + hall sensor paths, leg B (mirrored) | right: leg B drivers and bootstrap, HF-cap footprints
